summary.text: Tom Downing is the Democratic candidate for the North Carolina State Senate, District 50, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Kevin Corbin (R).

paragraphs.text: Tom Downing said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is running for a new Democratic majority in the General Assembly and wants to work with rural and urban legislators on affordable housing, affordable child care and rising health insurance costs.
He said he would not distribute negative campaign literature against his opponent and would hold frequent town halls, listening sessions and office hours in each of the district's eight counties.
Downing also listed public school funding, public safety pay and benefits, volunteer fire department funding, infrastructure, and ending gerrymandering among the areas he cares about.
